figures.annotation:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в издадените разрешения за строеж на нови сгради за периода от 2012 г. до 2022 г. Оста X няма общо текстово наименование, но представя времева линейна скала, обхващаща диапазона от 2012 г. до 2022 г. Етикетите по оста са числови с добавено съкращението „г.“ и са разположени през равномерни интервали от една година. Оста Y също няма текстово наименование и не съдържа числови етикети или скала по вертикалата. Въпреки наличието на хоризонтални мрежови линии, стойностите са представени единствено чрез числови етикети, разположени директно около точките на самите графики, като видимият диапазон варира от 70 до 8169. Не са посочени специфични мерни единици.

Синята линия, обозначена в легендата като „Административни“, е плътна, без добавени маркери. Тя започва от стойност 170 през 2012 г., спада до 156 през 2013 г. и достига локален връх от 187 през 2014 г. Следва спад до 157 през 2015 г. и леко покачване до 163 през 2016 г. През 2017 г. стойността намалява до 127, задържа се почти без промяна през 2018 г. на 128, след което продължава да спада до 103 през 2019 г. и 95 през 2020 г. През 2021 г. се отчита стойност 96, а крайната точка през 2022 г. бележи най-ниската стойност от 70.

Оранжевата линия, обозначена като „Други“, е плътна и без маркери. Тя започва от 4938 през 2012 г. и спада до 4674 през 2013 г. и 4323 през 2014 г. В периода от 2014 г. до 2017 г. линията визуално се покачва, преминавайки през 4382 през 2015 г., 4685 през 2016 г. и достигайки връх за този период от 5460 през 2017 г. След това се наблюдава спад през 4826 за 2018 г. и 4608 за 2019 г., достигайки до най-ниската си стойност от 3944 през 2020 г. Линията се покачва до 4685 през 2021 г. и завършва с лек спад на стойност 4631 през 2022 г.

Сивата линия, обозначена като „Жилищни“, е плътна, без маркери. Началната ѝ стойност е 4238 през 2012 г. След първоначален спад до 4120 през 2013 г., линията бележи период на непрекъснато покачване в продължение на шест години. Тя преминава през 4245 (2014 г.), 4310 (2015 г.), 4514 (2016 г.), 5562 (2017 г.), 5774 (2018 г.) и достига 5980 през 2019 г. През 2020 г. се отчита лек спад до 5860. След тази точка линията се изкачва до 7047 през 2021 г. и завършва с най-високата стойност на цялата графика от 8169 през 2022 г.

figures.annotation: Фигурата представлява линейна диаграма, която илюстрира промените във времето на сключените договори в сектор „Строителство“, финансирани по оперативни програми. Оста X няма изрично текстово наименование, но показва времеви период, използвайки линейна скала с диапазон от 2013 г. до 2022 г., като етикетите са разположени през равномерни интервали от една година. Графиката не разполага с традиционна вертикална ос Y с разграфена скала и интервали; вместо това числовите стойности са изписани директно като етикети до всяка точка на пречупване по линиите. Легендата дефинира две променливи: „Брой“ и „Стойност, млн. лв.“. Оранжевата плътна линия без допълнителни графични маркери, визуализираща стойността, започва в началото на оста X със стойност 3 203,4 през 2013 г. и показва последователен спад до най-ниската си точка от 519,4 през 2016 г. След това линията се покачва стъпалообразно, достигайки локален връх от 2 990,5 през 2019 г., понижава се леко през 2020 г. и по-рязко до 1 946,9 през 2021 г., след което завършва с покачване до 2 818,2 в края на оста X през 2022 г. Синята плътна линия, също без графични маркери, представяща броя на договорите, стартира от 719 през 2013 г., покачва се до 825 през 2014 г., след което отбелязва спад до визуален минимум от 186 през 2016 г. В следващите години линията отчита плавен растеж, достигайки максимална стойност за своя набор от данни в размер на 852 през 2020 г., преди да спадне плавно до 436 през 2022 г.

figures.annotation: Изображението представлява триизмерна кръгова диаграма, която показва честотата на използване на стандартни договори на FIDIC за международни строителни проекти. Диаграмата е разделена на общо четири сектора. В долната част на изображението е включена легенда, която обозначава съответните категории, а в двата най-големи сектора са поставени етикети с точни проценти вътре в самите тях. Най-големият сектор е оцветен в жълто, съответства на категорията „никога“ от легендата и е маркиран със стойност 57.1%. Вторият по големина сектор е сив, отговаря на етикета „по-малко от 10“ и съдържа стойност 26.2%. Третият сектор е оранжев, представлява категорията „между 10 и 20“ и няма изрично отбелязан процент. Най-малкият сектор е син, обозначен е в легендата като „20 или повече“ и също не съдържа цифров етикет. Визуално секторите са подредени по нарастващ размер по посока на часовниковата стрелка, като се започне от най-малкия син сектор в горната централна част. Нито един от секторите не е визуално подчертан чрез отделяне, изместване или удебеляване спрямо цялостната форма на диаграмата.

figures.annotation: 此图表展示了模型词汇量大小对不同模型性能指标的影响。x轴的标签为“模型词汇量”，采用分类刻度，包含从左至右依次排列的六个数据节点：mBERT-0、mBERT-10、mBERT-30、mBERT-50、mBERT-80和mBERT-100。y轴的标签为“性能指标 (%)”，采用线性刻度，可见网格线标注的数值范围从82到90，单位为%，数值刻度间隔为2。图表中共有三条带有圆形标记的实线。第一条蓝色实线代表“Precision (精度)”，其数值从x轴起始点mBERT-0处的最低点（低于刻度82）开始上升，在mBERT-10至mBERT-30节点区间内的上升幅度相对平缓，随后继续攀升，并在终点mBERT-100处达到该线的最高点（略低于刻度90）。第二条红色实线代表“Recall (召回率)”，从mBERT-0处起步（介于刻度82和84之间），沿着x轴呈现出持续上升的趋势，最终在mBERT-100处达到最高点（高于刻度90）。第三条绿色实线代表“F1 Score (F1分数)”，从mBERT-0处（略高于刻度82）开始，随着x轴类别的推进保持稳步上升，在终点mBERT-100处达到其最高点（略低于刻度90）。三条线在整个x轴区间内均保持上升趋势，未出现下降现象。

figures.annotation: 这张柱状图展示了不同知识表示方法在GSC+数据集上对模型性能的影响。水平轴包含类别，标签为“基座模型”，从左到右依次列出了三个离散的类别：BioBERT、Bioformer和PubMedBERT。垂直轴是值轴，标签为“F1值”，采用线性数值刻度，数值范围从0.71到0.77，刻度间隔均匀，为0.01。图表包含分组的柱状图，每个基座模型类别下并排排列着六个柱子。根据图例，这些柱子的不同颜色代表不同的方法：Original（浅红色）、Random（粉色）、TransE（浅橙色）、TransR（浅黄色）、ConvE（浅绿色）和SemNE（浅蓝色）。每个柱子的顶部都直接标注了确切的数值。在整个图表中，最短的柱子是Bioformer组的Original方法，数值为0.720；最长的柱子是BioBERT组的TransR方法，数值为0.757。具体到各个分组，BioBERT组的数值范围从0.738（Original）到0.757（TransR），Bioformer组的数值从0.720（Original）到0.748（SemNE），PubMedBERT组的数值从0.734（Random）到0.753（TransR）。柱状图未按字母或数值大小进行整体排序，而是每组内部严格保持与图例一致的方法排列顺序。除了所有柱子顶部均带有数值注释外，图表没有使用阴影、加粗或轮廓等视觉手段对任何特定柱子进行额外强调。
figures.caption: 不同知识表示方法在GSC+数据集上对模型的性能影响
figures.paper_title: 基于本体信息增强的人类表型概念识别

figures.annotation: 该垂直堆叠柱状图展示了发文前十机构逐年的发文量情况。水平类目轴的标签为“年份”，包含从1994至2023的连续年份，按时间先后顺序线性排列。垂直值轴的标签为“发文量/篇”，采用线性数值刻度，数值范围从0到45，刻度间隔均匀，每隔5为一个刻度单元。图表中的柱子采用垂直堆叠的排列方式，每根柱子的总高度代表特定年份十所机构的总发文量。根据图表上方的图例，堆叠的各组成部分代表不同的科研机构，并用不同颜色区分：南京大学为蓝色，复旦大学为橙色，山东大学为灰色，上海师范大学为黄色，北京大学为浅蓝色，中山大学为浅绿色，中国社会科学院为深蓝色，四川大学为棕色，北京外国语大学为深灰色，南开大学为橄榄绿色。柱状图严格按照年份的先后顺序进行排列，图表中未见阴影、轮廓等特殊的视觉强调特征。在所展示的数据中，1994、1995以及1997至2001年没有显示柱形，表示这些年份的发文量约为0。最短的可见柱形出现在1996、2003、2004和2005年，其总高度均近似为1篇；最长的柱形出现在2022年，其堆叠总高度精确达到40篇。此外，2014至2018年以及2021年的柱状图总高度大多处于20至26篇之间。

figures.annotation: 该饼图展示了近三十年域外汉籍研究领域中“刊文量前二十期刊分布图”。图表共划分为20个切片，并在图形的左右两侧分别设有一列图例，通过不同的颜色方块标注了这20种期刊的名称。观察图表可知，切片从底部（约6点钟方向）开始，按顺时针方向呈现面积逐渐递减的排列顺序。其中，最大的一块切片为翠绿色，代表“域外汉籍研究集刊”，其内部标注有67%的比例标签；紧接着顺时针排列的是黄绿色切片（汉籍与汉学），标注为7%；随后依次是深青色切片（文献）占3%，浅橙色切片（图书馆杂志）占3%，珊瑚红色切片（图书馆论坛）占2%，浅紫色切片（文学遗产）占2%，以及深绿色切片（中国典籍与文化）占2%。在这些较大类别之后，剩余的13个切片在图表左上部区域依次变得极为狭窄，其内部虽附有白色的数字标签，但因空间受限而发生重叠，难以清晰读取精确百分比。这些较小比例的切片根据颜色顺时针依次对应左侧图例下方的橄榄绿色（国际汉学）、深蓝色（图书馆理论与实践）、棕褐色（古籍整理研究学刊），以及右侧图例中的红色（学习与探索）、深紫色（大学图书馆学报）、青色（中国文化研究）、青绿色（新世纪图书馆）、天蓝色（复旦学报(社会科学版)）、浅肤色（清华大学学报(哲学社会科学版)）、粉色（浙江大学学报(人文社会科学版)）、浅紫色（图书馆建设）、深绿色（国外社会科学）和亮绿色（文史哲）。图表中足够大的切片均包含了内部的白色百分比标签，图表边缘带有轻微的阴影效果，但并未对任何单个切片进行分离、偏移或加粗等特定的视觉强调处理。
figures.caption: 刊文量前二十期刊分布图
figures.paper_title: 近三十年域外汉籍研究的现状与展望—基于文献计量分析和知识图谱绘制

figures.annotation: The image presents two nested pie charts, or sunburst diagrams, comparing the clustering statistics for "AttentionInfluence" on the left and "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" on the right. Neither chart includes a standalone legend; instead, category labels and numerical values—which sum to 100 in the inner rings, indicating percentages—are placed directly inside the slices or connected via pointing arrows. Both charts are visually emphasized using an exploded format, where all slices are slightly separated by white space. The segments are grouped by color into an inner ring of broad categories and an outer ring of subcategories, though they do not appear to be ordered by strictly descending size. The left chart contains 22 total slices (6 inner and 16 outer). Its inner ring features mint green Education 25, orange History & Society 23, light blue Health & Medicine 22, pink-red Science 15, brown Tech & Engineer 12, and cyan Fin & Law 3. Its corresponding outer ring contains mint green Teaching & resources 15 and Science & technology education 10; light blue Diseases 11, Medical 6, and Nutrition 5; orange Society & culture 10, Historical review 7, and Events & people 6; pink-red Animal & Plant 13 and Materials 2; brown Infor tech 5, Emerging tech 4, and Materials 3; and cyan Manage 2 and Policy 1. The right chart contains 21 total slices (6 inner and 15 outer). The inner ring consists of mint green Education 38, light blue Health & Medicine 19, orange History & Society 19, pink-red Science 15, brown Tech & Engineer 8, and a small cyan slice labeled with an ellipsis (...). Its outer ring includes mint green Science & technology education 19, Teaching & resources 17, and Healthy education 2; light blue Diseases 10, Nutrition 7, and Medical 2; orange Historical review 12, Society & culture 5, and Events & people 2; pink-red Animal & Plant 12 and Materials 3; brown Emerging tech 4, Infor tech 3, and Materials 1; and a single cyan slice for Manage 1.
figures.caption: The statistics of clustering. The left is the clustering result of AttentionInfluence, the right part is that of FineWeb-Edu Classifier.

figures.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relative change for different configurations of token counts and bit precisions across varying model layer groups. The categorical x-axis represents layer groupings with ticks labeled sequentially as "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and uses a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, with grid lines and tick marks spaced at 5% intervals. A grey dashed line without markers represents the "Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit," which remains constant at exactly 0% across all x-axis categories. A yellow solid line with circle markers represents "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit," which begins near 0% at Layer1-4, exhibits a slight dip to approximately -1% at Layer5-12, returns to 0% at Layer13-20, dips slightly to -0.5% at Layer21-28, and concludes at a peak of roughly 0.5% at Layer29-32. A coral-red solid line with square markers denotes "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit," starting slightly above 0% at Layer1-4, declining to approximately -2.5% at Layer5-12, maintaining a stable trend near -2% through Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and rising to end at approximately -0.2% at Layer29-32. A light blue solid line with circle markers represents "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit," beginning around -0.5% at Layer1-4, declining to roughly -2.5% at Layer5-12, reaching its lowest point of approximately -6% at Layer13-20, and then rising to roughly -4% at Layer21-28 before ending at approximately -1% at Layer29-32. Finally, a dark blue solid line with square markers indicates "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit," which begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, drops to -5.5% at Layer5-12, experiences a steep decline to its minimum value of -14.5% at Layer13-20, and then steadily increases to -11% at Layer21-28, finishing at approximately -1.5% at Layer29-32.
figures.caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
figures.paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression

figures.annotation: This line plot illustrates the relative change across different categorical layer groupings for various token multiplier and bit-precision configurations. The categorical x-axis lacks a general label but displays discrete layer intervals from left to right: "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis represents "Relative Change" on a linear scale, with values ranging from -25% to 5% and labeled tick marks at -25%, -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. The plot contains five distinct lines. The "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" is represented by a grey dashed line with no markers, which remains steady at exactly 0% across all x-axis intervals. The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" line is a solid yellow line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 0% at Layer1-4, shows a minor decline to roughly -1.5% at Layer13-20, and slightly increases to end at roughly 0.5% at Layer29-32. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" line is a solid red line with square markers, starting at 0% at Layer1-4, dipping to approximately -4.5% at Layer13-20, and recovering to roughly -0.5% by Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" line is a solid light blue line with circular markers that begins at roughly -1.5% at Layer1-4, experiences a noticeable drop to approximately -12.5% at Layer13-20, and rises back to end at near -1.5% at Layer29-32. Finally, the "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" line is a solid dark blue line with square markers; it starts at approximately -2.5% at Layer1-4, undergoes a sharp decline to a minimum value of exactly -25% at Layer13-20, and steeply ascends to end at roughly -3% at Layer29-32.

figures.annotation: This line plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different configurations as a function of the number of completions. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions ($k$)", utilizes a logarithmic scale with base 2, ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$ with tick labels uniformly spaced at each power of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", uses a linear scale with a plotted data range from approximately 0.25 to 0.95 and features major tick marks at intervals of 0.2, specifically at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The data for "Llama-3B" is represented by a solid dark blue line with circle markers, which shows a steady upward trend starting at roughly 0.43 at $x=2^0$ and increasing to approximately 0.91 at $x=2^8$. The "Llama-3B + FT" data is shown by a dotted dark green line with upward-pointing triangle markers, similarly increasing from about 0.43 at $x=2^0$, passing through 0.71 at $x=2^3$, and ending at roughly 0.91 at $x=2^8$. The "Llama-1B" configuration is depicted by a solid light blue line with circle markers, demonstrating a continuous rise from approximately 0.25 at $x=2^0$, through 0.64 at $x=2^4$, up to about 0.86 at $x=2^8$. Finally, the "Llama-1B + FT" data is illustrated by a dotted light green line with upward-pointing triangle markers, displaying a steady increase that begins near 0.25 at $x=2^0$, reaches approximately 0.55 at $x=2^3$, and concludes at roughly 0.86 at $x=2^8$.

figures.annotation: The plot illustrates majority voting accuracy based on the number of completions. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions ($k$)" and utilizes a base-2 logarithmic scale ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$, with tick marks at every power of 2 ($2^0, 2^1, 2^2, 2^3, 2^4, 2^5, 2^6, 2^7, 2^8$). The y-axis is labeled "Majority voting accuracy" and uses a linear scale with a visible range extending from just below 0.3 to slightly above 0.6, featuring numeric tick labels positioned at 0.1 intervals from 0.3 to 0.6. The plot displays four distinct lines. A solid dark blue line with circle markers begins at a value of approximately 0.43 at $2^0$, increases to about 0.49 at $2^2$, and continues an upward trend to end at approximately 0.61 at $2^8$. A dotted dark green line with upward-pointing triangle markers starts at approximately 0.43 at $2^0$, remains flat to $2^1$, and then rises steadily to conclude at approximately 0.61 at $2^7$. A solid light blue line with circle markers begins at roughly 0.25 at $2^0$, increases to about 0.30 at $2^2$, and climbs steadily to finish at approximately 0.43 at $2^8$. Finally, a dotted light green line with upward-pointing triangle markers begins at roughly 0.25 at $2^0$, stays level to $2^1$, and then follows an upward trajectory to end at approximately 0.43 at $2^7$.

figures.annotation: This donut chart, a variation of a pie chart, displays the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs. The chart is divided into 10 distinct slices separated by thin white borders, with the bolded text "Stimulus Type" positioned in the central empty space. Reading clockwise starting from the top right, the segments include "Draft/Other" in dark red (26.4%), "Event Posting" in dark brown (6.6%), "Organizational Report" in muted purple (7.7%), "Organizational Website" in light purple (4.9%), "Interview" in dark navy blue (8.8%), "Intra-agency news article" in medium blue (4.9%), "External News Article" in dark green (18.1%), "Email" in light green (2.7%), "Press Release" in gold (18.7%), and "Social Media Post" in orange (1.1%). The slices do not follow a specific ascending or descending size order, and no individual segments are visually exploded or offset from the main ring.

figures.annotation: This line plot illustrates the effect of vocabulary size on accuracy for two different tokenizers, identified in the legend as "universal" and "cluster." The x-axis lacks an explicit axis label but displays discrete values representing vocabulary size, with categorical tick marks evenly spaced at 100k, 175k, and 250k. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and employs a linear scale with a visible range extending just below 40.5 to exactly 42.0, featuring numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.5. The "universal" tokenizer is represented by a solid blue line with star-shaped markers. It exhibits a continuous upward trend across the x-axis, starting at an accuracy of approximately 40.45 at 100k, rising to roughly 41.13 at 175k, and concluding at a peak of approximately 41.87 at 250k. The "cluster" tokenizer is depicted by a solid orange line with circular markers. This line begins at an accuracy of approximately 41.62 at 100k, increases slightly to reach a peak of roughly 41.76 at 175k, and then declines to finish at approximately 41.42 at 250k.

figures.annotation: This nested donut chart represents the distribution of samples across three primary categories and nine specific capabilities. The chart consists of two concentric rings separated by thick white borders, totaling twelve distinct slices arranged around a hollow center. The inner ring contains three overarching categories labeled with bold white text directly inside the segments: "Contradiction Resolution" in brown, "Context Tracking" in dark blue, and "Context Retrieving" in dark teal. The outer ring is divided into nine sub-capability slices that visually correspond to the inner categories. These outer slices do not have percentage labels; instead, they are labeled outside the chart with black text and numerical sample counts connected by thin blue lines. Adjacent to "Contradiction Resolution" are "Prioritization" (light salmon, 100), "Personalization" (orange-red, 100), and "Privacy Protection" (bright red, 111). Aligned with "Context Tracking" are "Triggering" (light blue, 100), "Recursive Reasoning" (bright blue, 110), and "Dynamic Environment" (medium blue, 100). Finally, mapped to "Context Retrieving" are "Memorization" (light aquamarine, 100), "Dynamic Instruction" (turquoise, 100), and "Multitasking" (teal, 160). The chart lacks a separate legend, and while the segments are not ordered in a strict ascending or descending sequence, the widths of the outer slices visually correspond to their numerical values, notably with the "Multitasking" slice (160) appearing wider than the others.

figures.annotation: The chart is a multi-level pie chart, specifically a sunburst chart, representing task-wise class distributions for a dataset labeled "TiALD," which is printed in the white central hole. It displays hierarchical data across three concentric rings using a color-coded scheme without an external legend, and it lacks explicit percentage or numerical labels, meaning proportions must be visually estimated. The innermost ring contains two primary slices: "Abusive," colored teal, which occupies roughly 55-60% of the total area, and "Not Abusive," colored yellow-orange, making up the remaining 40-45%. The middle ring subdivides these primary categories into ten visible slices that match the color of their parent category. Within the teal "Abusive" section, the subdivisions appear ordered visually by descending size in a counter-clockwise direction: "Political," "Other," "Racial," "Sexist," and a narrow "Religious" slice. The yellow-orange "Not Abusive" section features middle-ring subdivisions ordered similarly by descending size: "Other," "Political," "Religious," and very thin slivers for "Sexist" and "Racial." The outermost ring further segments these groups into approximately 30 visible slices of varying sizes. The outer teal slices are predominantly labeled "Negative," accompanied by smaller "Mixed" slices and several narrow, unreadable slivers, while the outer yellow-orange slices show a wider distribution of labels including "Positive," "Neutral," "Negative," and "Mixed." All labels are placed directly inside their respective slices, with the text often rotated to follow the chart's circular curvature, and no segments are visually emphasized, offset, or exploded.

figures.paper_title: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Abusive Language Detection in Low-Resource   Settings

figures.annotation: The provided image is a two-level nested donut chart representing a task taxonomy, divided into an inner ring representing broad analytical layers and an outer ring detailing specific types of analysis within those layers. The chart consists of a total of 20 slices: 4 in the inner ring and 16 in the outer ring. The inner ring contains four slices that include text labels and exact percentage values directly inside the segments. Visually arranged roughly in descending order of size in a clockwise direction, these inner slices are: "Semantic Layer (41.2%)" colored in light blue-grey, "Perception Layer(40.4%)" in dark blue, "Cultural Layer (14.1%)" in light grey, and "Signal Layer(4.3%)" in medium blue. The outer ring provides further subdivisions without percentage labels, generally matching the color families of their corresponding inner layers. The "Semantic Layer" expands into three light blue-grey outer slices: "Content Analysis," "Emotion & Intention," and "Speaker Analysis." The "Perception Layer" is subdivided into six lighter medium-blue outer slices: "Environmental Perception & Reasoning," "Counting & Statistics," "Music Theory," "Correlation Analysis," "Temporal Analysis," and "Spatial Analysis." The "Cultural Layer" corresponds to four light grey outer slices: "Professional Knowl & Reasoning," "Culture of Speaker," "Imagination," and a very thin slice labeled "Asthetic Analysis." Finally, the "Signal Layer" corresponds to three medium blue outer slices: "Acoustic Quality Analysis," "AnomalyDetection," and a very thin slice labeled "Audio Difference Analysis." There is no separate legend, as all information is integrated directly onto or adjacent to the chart. The chart features a central blank circular hole, and while no slices are exploded or bolded, thin grey leader lines are utilized to connect the labels for "Asthetic Analysis" and "Audio Difference Analysis" to their visually narrow respective slices.

figures.annotation: This pie chart displays the error distribution in Audio-Reasoner, divided into seven distinct categories. The slices are arranged sequentially by size, ordered in an ascending manner clockwise starting from the top vertical axis. The smallest slice, colored pale turquoise, represents "Wrong Understanding of Instruction" at 3%, followed by a pale cyan slice for "Choice Format Error" at 4%, and a sky blue slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 9%. Continuing clockwise, the next slice is light blue and labeled "Repeat Thinking and No Answer" at 12%, followed by a periwinkle slice representing "Correct Answer but Wrong Choice" at 15%. A lavender slice denotes "Reasoning Error" at 20%, and finally, the largest slice, colored light purple, accounts for "Perceptual Error" at 37%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the four largest segments contain their text labels and percentages directly inside the slices, while the three smallest segments have their text labels and percentages positioned outside the chart with thin black arrows pointing to their respective slices. All segments are separated by thin white border lines, and no individual slices are exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized.

figures.annotation: This pie chart represents the relative share of the most frequent languages in a dataset, displaying a total of 10 categories. The chart does not use a separate legend; instead, the language labels are positioned around the outer perimeter, while the corresponding percentage values are located inside each slice. The segments are visually ordered in a counter-clockwise direction starting from the top left, arranged by descending size and represented by a monochromatic color scale that transitions from dark to light blue. The largest segment is "English" in dark blue at 42.8%, followed by "Spanish" in a medium blue at 31.4%. Continuing counter-clockwise, the slices progressively decrease in size and lighten in shade: "Russian" (5.7%), "German" (3.6%), "French" (2.9%), "Chinese" (2.5%), "Thai" (1.9%), "Portuguese (Brazil)" (1.7%), and "Catalan" (1.6%). The sequence concludes at the top right with the "Other" category, which is depicted in the lightest pale blue and accounts for 5.8% of the total, breaking the strict descending size order. No individual slices are visually emphasized by being exploded or offset, though the font sizes of the text labels generally scale with the size of their respective segments.
figures.caption: Left: Relative share of the most frequent languages in the dataset. Right: Distribution of contributions among users.

figures.annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of different methods on TruthfulQA. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations," utilizing a linear scale with a range from 0 to 2000 and numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled "MC1," employing a linear scale with a visible range extending slightly below 37 to above 39, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot contains three distinct lines. The "Linear SAE" method is represented by a dark blue solid line with circular markers. This line starts near an x-value of 25 at a y-value of approximately 37.1, stays flat at x=50, then rises steeply to roughly 37.45 at x=100 and 38.05 at x=250. It climbs more gradually to about 38.2 at x=750 and reaches a local peak of about 38.3 at x=1000. The line then dips to approximately 38.05 at x=1500 before rising sharply to end at its highest y-value of roughly 39.4 at x=2000. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" method is shown as a pink dash-dotted line with no markers, maintaining a steady, constant horizontal trend across the entire x-axis at a y-value of approximately 36.95, accompanied by a corresponding text label just above the right side of the line. The "ICD" method is depicted as a cyan dashed line with no markers, remaining completely steady across the entire x-axis at a y-value of approximately 37.85, accompanied by the text label "ICD (Prompt version)" situated just below the right side of the line.
figures.caption: : Left: Accuracy of all methods on each group of bias type in BBQ. Right: results on BBQ's testing set. All methods are applied on LLaMA-2-Chat-7B. For accuracy (A%_{}), higher values are better; for unknown-answer response rate (U%_{}), bias score (BS%_{}) and stereotypical response rate (SR%_{}), lower is better. We use bold font for the best result in each column, and mark the methods that improve ICL. : significant improvements on ICL in A% by pair-wise t-test with p < 0.05.
figures.paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment

figures.annotation: This plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the accuracy of different methods across a varying number of demonstrations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick marks regularly spaced at intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and employs a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 5, specifically shown at 45, 50, and 55. The "Squared-Exponential" line is depicted as a dark blue solid line with circular markers; it begins at an accuracy of approximately 53 near 25 demonstrations, rises to about 56 at 250 demonstrations, and maintains a steady trend to end at roughly 56.5 at 1500 demonstrations. The "Tanh" line is shown as a medium blue solid line with circular markers, starting near an accuracy of 48 at 25 demonstrations and remaining relatively flat across the x-axis to end at approximately 48 at 1500 demonstrations. The "ELU" line is represented by a light blue solid line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 46.5 near 25 demonstrations and exhibiting a steady trend throughout to end at roughly 46.5 at 1500 demonstrations. Finally, the "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is a pink dash-dot line without markers that remains constant at an accuracy value of approximately 43 across the entire range of the x-axis.
figures.caption: MC1 scores of SEA by using a different number of demonstrations. A higher score indicates a better performance. We find that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations on both TruthfulQA and BBQ for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model.

figures.annotation: This line plot illustrates length extrapolation results on the EgoSchema dataset by representing the performance of four different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and features a linear scale encompassing a data range from 8 to 64, with numeric tick labels marked at regular intervals of 10 from 10 to 60. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and employs a linear scale with a plotted range from roughly 39 to 54.5, displaying tick labels at regular intervals of 2 from 40 to 54. The line for "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" is plotted as a thick solid blue line with circular markers outlined in white; it begins at an x-value of 8 with a y-value of approximately 53, rises to a peak of 54 at x=16, and then exhibits a slight decline to approximately 53.8 at x=32 before ending at roughly 53.6 at x=64. The line representing "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" appears as a thick solid green line with white-outlined circular markers, starting at x=8 with an accuracy of approximately 52.6, increasing to roughly 53.6 at x=16, rising slightly to about 53.8 at x=32, and remaining steady at that value until the end of the data range at x=64. The "PLLaVA (DP 8)" line is a thick solid orange line with white-outlined square markers; it begins at x=8 with a value of 45 and shows a continuous decline across its plotted points, dropping to 43 at x=16, 41 at x=32, and concluding at approximately 39.4 at x=64. Finally, the "PLLaVA (DP 16)" line is depicted as a thick solid red line with white-outlined square markers that commences at x=16 with a value of approximately 45.6, then steadily declines to about 43.8 at x=32 and finishes at roughly 42.2 at x=64.
figures.caption: Length extrapolation results on EgoSchema dataset.
figures.paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges

figures.annotation: The plot illustrates the memory usage of five different models as the number of frames increases. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to slightly beyond 1000, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Memory (GB)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to roughly 425, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 50. The line for VideoLLaMB is a solid pink line with circular markers, though it is almost completely obscured by the visually identical trajectory of the VideoLLaMB-R line. The VideoLLaMB-R line is a solid olive-gold line with circular markers, starting at approximately 18 GB at near zero frames and rising very gradually to roughly 38 GB at the final data point just past 1000 frames. The line for PLLaVA is a solid green line with circular markers, starting near 18 GB and showing a steady, moderate increase to approximately 75 GB at the end of the x-axis. The line for LLaVA-NeXT is a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning near 18 GB and increasing steadily across the chart, ending at approximately 145 GB. Finally, the line for VideoLLaVA is a solid purple line with circular markers that starts near 18 GB and exhibits a steep, rapid increase; it records values of roughly 120 GB near 125 frames and 230 GB near 250 frames, before continuing sharply upward and exiting the top boundary of the plot prior to the 400-frame mark.
figures.caption: GPU Memory Cost. We apply all the experiments on a single NVIDIA A800 GPU.
figures.paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges

figures.annotation: Das Liniendiagramm stellt die wirtschaftspolitische Unsicherheit in den USA anhand von drei verschiedenen Indizes über die Zeit dar. Die x-Achse besitzt keine explizite textliche Beschriftung, zeigt jedoch eine lineare Zeitskala in Jahren, die den Zeitraum von 2016 bis kurz nach 2024 umfasst. Die numerischen Beschriftungen der Hauptstriche erfolgen in regelmäßigen Abständen von zwei Jahren (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024), mit unbeschrifteten Zwischenmarkierungen für die ungeraden Jahre. Das Diagramm verfügt über zwei y-Achsen, die beide oberhalb der Achse mit „Index“ beschriftet sind und eine lineare Skalierung aufweisen. Die linke y-Achse reicht von 0 bis 1.000 in Intervallen von 100, während die rechte y-Achse von 0 bis 9.000 in Intervallen von 1.000 reicht. Die durchgezogene schwarze Linie ohne Markierungen repräsentiert laut Legende die „Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt“ und orientiert sich an der linken Skala. Sie beginnt im Jahr 2016 bei einem Wert von etwa 100, fluktuiert bis Anfang 2020 überwiegend im Bereich zwischen 50 und 200 und verzeichnet Anfang 2020 einen deutlichen Höhepunkt bei etwa 500, bevor sie wieder absinkt, bis Mitte 2024 zwischen 100 und 200 schwankt und am Ende der x-Achse abrupt auf einen Wert von etwas über 700 ansteigt. Die durchgezogene hellblaue Linie ohne Markierungen stellt die „Finanzpolitik“ dar, welche ebenfalls an der linken y-Achse abgelesen wird. Sie startet 2016 bei ungefähr 100, schwankt in den Folgejahren ebenfalls meist unterhalb von 200 und erreicht Anfang 2020 eine Spitze von etwa 450, gefolgt von einem Rückgang auf Werte meist zwischen 50 und 200 bis Mitte 2024 und einem abschließenden, steilen Anstieg auf ungefähr 650 am rechten Diagrammrand. Die durchgezogene violette Linie ohne Markierungen zeigt die „Handelspolitik“ auf Basis der rechten y-Achse. Sie beginnt 2016 nahe 0, zeigt zwischen 2018 und 2020 mehrere Ausschläge mit Spitzenwerten um die 2.000, fällt danach auf Werte nahe 0 zurück und verläuft bis Mitte 2024 sehr flach, bevor sie am äußersten Ende der x-Achse einen massiven, nahezu vertikalen Anstieg verzeichnet, der bei einem Wert von knapp 8.000 endet.

figures.annotation: Das Diagramm stellt die Exporte und Importe von Waren sowie den Handelsbilanzsaldo der USA im Zeitverlauf dar. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Zeit auf einer linearen Skala, beginnend im Jahr 2020. Die Hauptbeschriftungen lauten 2020, 2021, 2022, gefolgt von drei aufeinanderfolgenden Beschriftungen mit der Jahreszahl 2023, wobei sich zwischen den Jahreszahlen jeweils elf unbeschriftete Teilstriche befinden, die monatliche Intervalle repräsentieren. Die linke y-Achse ist am oberen Rand mit "in Mrd. US-Dollar" beschriftet, verläuft auf einer linearen Skala mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 400 und weist in regelmäßigen Abständen von 50 Einheiten numerische Beschriftungen auf. Die rechte y-Achse, die sich auf den als hellblaue vertikale Balken dargestellten Saldo bezieht, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala mit einem Bereich von -200 bis 400 und numerischen Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 100 Einheiten. Die Linie für die Importe ist durchgehend, blau, weist keine Datenpunktmarkierungen auf und bezieht sich auf die linke Skala. Sie beginnt Anfang 2020 bei einem Wert von etwa 200 Mrd. US-Dollar, sinkt kurz darauf auf einen Tiefstwert von etwa 165 Mrd. US-Dollar, steigt dann kontinuierlich bis auf einen ersten Höhepunkt von circa 290 Mrd. US-Dollar Anfang 2022 an, verläuft anschließend unter leichten Schwankungen zwischen etwa 255 und 280 Mrd. US-Dollar und steigt am rechten Rand der x-Achse steil auf ihren Maximalwert von etwa 350 Mrd. US-Dollar an. Die Linie für die Exporte ist durchgehend, violett, besitzt ebenfalls keine Markierungen und bezieht sich auf die linke Skala. Diese Linie startet Anfang 2020 bei circa 135 Mrd. US-Dollar, fällt kurzzeitig auf einen Tiefstpunkt von etwa 90 Mrd. US-Dollar ab und verzeichnet danach einen allmählichen Anstieg bis auf einen Höchstwert von etwa 180 Mrd. US-Dollar im Jahr 2022. Im weiteren Verlauf bis zum Ende der x-Achse verbleibt die violette Linie mit nur minimalen Schwankungen auf einem relativ konstanten Niveau und endet bei einem Wert von ebenfalls etwa 180 Mrd. US-Dollar.

figures.annotation: Das Liniendiagramm veranschaulicht die Entwicklung des THE Sommer-Winter-Spreads seit April 2024. Die x-Achse besitzt keine übergeordnete Achsenbeschriftung, stellt jedoch den zeitlichen Verlauf auf einer linearen Skala vom Beginn des Zeitraums im April 2024 bis zum Ende im Februar 2025 dar; die regelmäßigen Tick-Beschriftungen sind im monatlichen Intervall angeordnet (von "Apr 2024" bis "Feb 2025") und schräg gestellt. Die y-Achse ist mit "Euro/MWh" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und deckt einen Wertebereich von -7 bis 3 ab, wobei die numerischen Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 1 angeordnet sind und eine durchgehende schwarze horizontale Linie den Wert 0 markiert. Das Diagramm enthält eine einzige durchgehende, blaue Linie ohne spezifische Markierungsformen für einzelne Datenpunkte. Die Linie beginnt Anfang April 2024 bei einem Wert von ungefähr 2 Euro/MWh und schwankt in den darauffolgenden Monaten relativ konstant auf einem Niveau zwischen etwa 1 und 2,5 Euro/MWh. Mitte Oktober 2024 verzeichnet die Linie einen scharfen Rückgang, fällt unter die Null-Linie und erreicht im November einen vorläufigen Tiefpunkt bei etwa -3,5 Euro/MWh. Danach steigt der Wert wieder an und bildet Ende Dezember 2024 eine Spitze bei knapp unter 0 Euro/MWh (etwa -0,2 Euro/MWh). figures.annotation:
Das erste Liniendiagramm zeigt die Terminpreiskurve für Sommerlieferungen von Gas im Marktgebiet von Trading Hub Europe. Die x-Achse besitzt keine explizite Beschriftung, stellt jedoch Jahreszahlen dar, verläuft auf einer linearen Skala und reicht vom Jahr 2025 bis 2027 mit regelmäßigen Intervallen von einem Jahr. Die y-Achse ist mit „Euro/MWh“ beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala, deckt einen Wertebereich von 0 bis 50 ab und weist Markierungsintervalle in numerischen Schritten von 10 auf. Das Diagramm enthält eine einzelne durchgezogene blaue Linie mit quadratischen Markierungen, die einen kontinuierlich sinkenden Verlauf über die x-Achse aufweist. Die Linie beginnt im Jahr 2025 bei einem Wert von knapp unter 50 Euro/MWh, fällt im Jahr 2026 auf etwa 38 Euro/MWh ab und endet im Jahr 2027 bei einem Wert von knapp über 30 Euro/MWh.

Das zweite Liniendiagramm stellt die Terminpreiskurve für Jahreslieferungen von Gas im selben Marktgebiet dar. Die x-Achse hat keine spezifische Beschriftung, repräsentiert Jahreszahlen auf einer linearen Skala und erstreckt sich über einen Bereich von 2026 bis 2029, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von einem Jahr angeordnet sind. Die y-Achse ist mit „Euro/MWh“ beschriftet, basiert auf einer linearen Skala mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 50 und zeigt Markierungen in Abständen von 10. In diesem Diagramm wird eine einzelne, durchgezogene blaue Linie mit quadratischen Markierungen abgebildet, die ebenfalls einen stetig abnehmenden Trend zeigt. Die Linie startet im Jahr 2026 bei exakt 40 Euro/MWh, sinkt im Jahr 2027 auf ungefähr 33 Euro/MWh, verringert sich weiter auf knapp unter 30 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2028 und erreicht ihren Endpunkt im Jahr 2029 bei einem Wert von rund 27 Euro/MWh.

[Bulgarian]
Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промените в стойностите на три различни категории спрямо общ параметър. Оста X е обозначена с етикет "M", използва линейна числова скала с диапазон от 3 до 8 и не съдържа специфични мерни единици, като етикетите ѝ са разположени през равномерни интервали от 1. Оста Y е обозначена с етикет "Perplexity", също използва линейна числова скала без посочени мерни единици, а видимите ѝ числови етикети обхващат диапазона от 20.0 до 40.0, разположени през равномерни интервали от 10.0. Графиката съдържа три линии, описани в легендата. Първата линия, с етикет "LLaMA1-7B", е представена с плътен зелен цвят и маркери под формата на кръгове; тя започва при X равно на 3 със стойност по Y около 28.0, отчита спад до около 24.0 при X равно на 5, след което се покачва до около 36.0 в края на оста X при стойност 8. Втората линия, с етикет "LLaMA1-13B", е плътна оранжева линия с маркери във формата на звезди; тя започва при X равно на 3 със стойност около 20.0, плавно спада до най-ниската си точка от около 16.0 при X равно на 6, след което се покачва и завършва отново на стойност около 20.0 при X равно на 8. Вертикалната ос показва стойностите, етикетирана е като "Perplexity" и използва логаритмична скала с основа 10. Диапазонът на оста обхваща стойности от под 10^1 до 10^3, като са поставени пунктирани хоризонтални мрежови линии на нива 10^1, 10^2 и 10^3. figures.annotation:
[Bulgarian]
Хоризонталната стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира резултатите от човешки оценки, като представя пропорционалното разпределение на три възможни изхода за различни езикови модели. Вертикалната ос съдържа категориите, които представляват имената на моделите, подредени отгоре надолу в следния произволен ред: Claude3.5, GPT4o и Doubao, без да е наличен изричен общ етикет на оста. Хоризонталната ос показва стойностите в линеен мащаб без изричен етикет, с диапазон от 0.0 до 1.0, като цифровите означения са разположени на равномерни интервали от по 0.2. Данните са представени чрез натрупани (stacked) стълбове, като всеки стълб достига обща стойност 1.0 и е разделен на три цветови сегмента, съответстващи на категориите от легендата, разположена под графиката: розов цвят за „Win“, светлосин за „Tie“ и светлозелен за „Lose“. Във вътрешността на всеки сегмент са изписани конкретни процентни стойности. За модела Claude3.5 разпределението е 32.0% за Win, 44.0% за Tie и 24.0% за Lose. При модела GPT4o делът на Win е най-голям и възлиза на 56.0%, последван от Lose с 26.0% и Tie с 18.0%. За модела Doubao сегментите са съответно 42.0% за Win, 36.0% за Tie и 22.0% за Lose. Категориите по вертикалната ос не са подредени по възходящ или низходящ ред на конкретна стойност или по азбучен ред, а самите стълбове не съдържат допълнителни визуални акценти като удебеляване или засенчване извън описаното цветово кодиране и вътрешните етикети.

This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the results of human evaluations for three evaluated systems. The vertical axis contains the categories, listing the models "Claude3.5", "GPT4o", and "Doubao" from top to bottom, without an explicit overarching axis label. The horizontal value axis features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, representing proportions, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. Each category is represented by a single stacked bar that extends exactly to the 1.0 mark, divided into three horizontal segments that correspond to the legend located at the bottom of the chart. From left to right within each bar, the stacked segments are colored light pink to represent a "Win," light blue to represent a "Tie," and light green to represent a "Lose." Every segment is visually emphasized with an explicit numerical percentage annotation centered within the colored block. For Claude3.5, the composition is 32.0% Win (the shortest Win segment), 44.0% Tie (the longest Tie segment), and 24.0% Lose. For GPT4o, the composition is 56.0% Win (the longest Win segment), 18.0% Tie (the shortest Tie segment), and 26.0% Lose (the longest Lose segment). For Doubao, the composition is 42.0% Win, 36.0% Tie, and 22.0% Lose (the shortest Lose segment). The categories on the vertical axis are not sorted alphabetically or by the descending or ascending value of any specific segment.

[German]
Das vorliegende horizontal gestapelte Balkendiagramm veranschaulicht die Ergebnisse menschlicher Bewertungen ("Results of Human Evaluations") für drei verschiedene Modelle. Die vertikale Kategorienachse listet die untersuchten Entitäten von unten nach oben in der Reihenfolge „Doubao“, „GPT4o“ und „Claude3.5“ auf; sie besitzt keine übergeordnete Achsenbeschriftung und weist keine alphabetische oder streng numerische Sortierung auf. Die horizontale Werteachse verfügt ebenfalls über keine explizite Achsenbeschriftung, nutzt jedoch eine lineare Skala mit einem Wertebereich von 0.0 bis 1.0 und gleichmäßigen Tick-Intervallen in Schritten von 0.2. Jeder der drei horizontalen Balken erstreckt sich über die gesamte Breite bis zum Wert 1.0 und ist in drei farbliche Segmente unterteilt, deren Bedeutung in einer Legende unterhalb der X-Achse aufgeschlüsselt wird: Hellrosa repräsentiert „Win“, Hellblau steht für „Tie“ und Hellgrün für „Lose“. Die Segmente sind innerhalb jedes Balkens von links nach rechts konsistent in dieser Reihenfolge angeordnet und jeweils zentriert mit exakten Prozentwerten annotiert. Für das Modell „Doubao“ auf der untersten Position betragen die annotierten Werte 42.0% für Win, 36.0% für Tie und 22.0% für Lose (der niedrigste Wert in der Lose-Kategorie). Bei „GPT4o“ in der Mitte verzeichnet das hellrosafarbene Win-Segment mit 56.0% den höchsten Wert dieser Kategorie im gesamten Diagramm, während das hellblaue Tie-Segment mit 18.0% den geringsten Anteil aller Modelle aufweist und das hellgrüne Lose-Segment 26.0% (den höchsten Wert in dieser Kategorie) beträgt. Der oberste Balken für „Claude3.5“ zeigt den geringsten Win-Anteil mit 32.0%, den höchsten Tie-Anteil mit 44.0% und einen Lose-Anteil von 24.0%. Spezifische visuelle Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettdruck sind über die Standardfärbung und die numerischen Anmerkungen innerhalb der Balken hinaus nicht vorhanden.

Графиката илюстрира сравнение на обявени обществени поръчки в строителния сектор, разделени по вид строителство, в периода от 2012 до 2022 г.

Оста X е етикетирана с години, от 2012 г. до 2022 г., използвайки линейна скала. Диапазонът на стойностите е от 2012 до 2022 с равномерно разположени етикети за всяка година.

Оста Y е етикетирана като "Обща стойност (хил. лв.)", с линейна скала, варираща от 0 до 8 169 хиляди лева. Етикетите са разположени с интервали от 1 000 хиляди лева.

Има три линии, представящи различни видове строителство: административни, други и жилищни. Линията за административни сгради е оцветена в синьо, с плътна линия и маркери във формата на кръгче. Тази линия започва от 4 238 хиляди лева в 2012 г. и достига 4 631 хиляди лева в 2013 г., след което намалява до 4 323 хиляди лева в 2014 г., достига до 4826 хиляди лева през 2018г. и завършва на 4 685 хиляди лева през 2022 г. Линията за "Други" е оцветена в червено, с плътна линия и маркери във формата на квадратче. Тази линия започва от 4 120 хиляди лева в 2012 г., достига своя връх от 5 562 хиляди лева в 2017г. и завършва на 3 944 хиляди лева през 2022 г. Линията за жилищно строителство е оцветена в жълто, с пунктирана линия и маркери във формата на триъгълник. Тази линия започва с 170 хиляди лева през 2012 г. и нараства до 8 169 хиляди лева към 2022 г.

figures.annotation:
Графиката илюстрира промените в броя и стойността (в милиони лева) на сключени строителни договори, финансирани по оперативни програми, за периода от 2013 до 2022 година.

Оста X представлява годините от 2013 до 2022, като етикетите са показани за всяка година. Скалата е линейна и равномерна.

Оста Y показва стойността в лева, дадена в милиони. Скалата е линейна и започва от 0, достигайки до приблизително 3200. Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 200 единици.

На графиката са представени две линии: синя пунктирана линия, обозначаваща броя на договорите, и червена плътна линия, обозначаваща стойността на договорите в милиони лева.
Синята линия започва от 719 през 2013 г., намалява до 519 през 2015 г., след това отново се увеличава до 985 през 2017 г., откъдето започва да намалява като достига 645 през 2019 г., 655 през 2020 г., 764 през 2021г. и 436 през 2022г.
Червената линия започва от 1828,2 през 2013 г., намалява до 1537,8 през 2015 г., след това се увеличава до 2990,5 през 2017 г., откъдето спада до 1946,9 през 2019 г., 2818,2 през 2021 г. и 2847,2 през 2022г.

Диаграмата илюстрира промените в броя и стойността на сключените строителни договори, финансирани от европейския бюджет, в строителния сектор в България за периода 2013-2022 г.

Оста X е надписана с години от 2013 г. до 2022 г. Скалата е линейна, като са обозначени всички години в посочения диапазон. Разстоянието между етикетите е равномерно.

Оста Y е разделена на две части: лявата страна е обозначена като „– Брой“, а дясната страна е обозначена като „– Стойност, млн. лв.“ В лявата част скалата е линейна, обхваща диапазон от 989 до 3 220. Към тази скала са редовно разположени стойности, като например 1000, 1500, 2000 и 2500. В дясната част скалата е линейна, обхваща диапазон от 1 846 до 5 667,2. Към тази скала са редовно разположени стойности, като например 2000, 3000, 4000 и 5000.

Две линии заемат основното място в графиката: първата е червена, плътна, с кръгли маркери, описваща стойността на договорите в милиони лева. Линията започва при стойност 1 846 на 2013 г. и се повишава до 2 871 на 2015 г., след което намалява до 1 694,2 на 2017 г. На 2018 г. стойността е 1 431,7, след което се увеличава до 2 689,9 на 2019 г. На 2020 г. стойността е 1 820, на 2021 г. намалява до 2 220 и на 2022 г. достига 2 576,2. Втората линия е синя, пунктирана, с триъгълни маркери, описваща броя на сключените договори. Линията започва при стойност 989 на 2013 г. и се увеличава до 1 233,8 на 2014 г., след което намалява до 2 335 на 2015 г. През 2016 г. има спад до 1 447, а през 2017 г. стойността е 2 170. През 2018 г. графиката показва ръст до 2 664, която бива последвана от спад до 2 605 през 2019 г. През 2020 г. броят е 1 846 и минава през ниска точка от 2 313 през 2021 г., достигайки 3 220 през 2022 г.

figures.annotation: Диаграмата е кръгова диаграма, която сравнява честотата на използване на стандартните договори на FIDIC за международни строителни проекти. Тя включва четири сектора, всеки от които е обозначен с различен цвят: златист, сив, светлокафяв и син. Секторите, оцветени в златист цвят, представляват отговора "винаги", заемат най-големият дял от диаграмата и са означени с 57.1%. Секторът, оцветен в сив цвят, представлява отговора „между 10 и 20“ и явява вторият по големина сектор с приблизително 26.2%.  Секторът, оцветен в светлокафяв цвят, обозначен като "по-малко от 10", е третият по големина и заема приблизително 10%. Последен е секторът, оцветен в син цвят, отговарящ на отговора "20 или повече" и представлява най-малкия сектор, изместващ около 6.7%. Диаграмата показва легенда, включваща етикетите за всеки сектор. Няма видими изпъкнали или подсилени сектори, нито проценти, отбелязани вътре в самите сектори. Секторите са подредени по низходящ размер.

figures.annotation: 该图表展示了不同大小的模型词汇量对三个指标——精确率、召回率和F1 分数的影响。x轴为“模型词汇量”，这是一个分类刻度，拥有五个不同的刻度：mBERT-0、mBERT-10、mBERT-30、mBERT-50 和 mBERT-80 和 mBERT-100。y轴为“性能指标”，一个线性刻度，范围从 82% 到 92%，刻度间隔为 2%。该图表包含三条线。一条为红色实线带有圆形标记，代表精确率。从mBERT-0起始于约 83% 逐渐升高，在 mBERT-10 时达到约 84%，保持稳定，在 mBERT-30 时变为 85% ，在 mBERT-50 时变为 86% ，在 mBERT-80 时变为 88% ，并最终在 mBERT-100 时达到 90%。另一条为绿色实线带有圆形标记，代表召回率。从mBERT-0起始于约 82%，逐渐升高到在 mBERT-10 时达到约 83%，在 mBERT-30 时达到约 84%，在 mBERT-50 时达到约 85%，在 mBERT-80 时达到约 87%，并最终在 mBERT-100 时达到 89%。最后一条为蓝色的虚线，带有圆形标记，代表F1 分数。从mBERT-0起始于约 83%，逐渐升高，在mBERT-10 时达到约 84%，在 mBERT-30 时达到约 85%，在 mBERT-50 时达到约 86%， 在 mBERT-80 时达到约 88% ，并最终在 mBERT-100 时达到约 89%。

figures.annotation: 此图表描绘了近三十年来十家机构的年度发文量，采用叠柱图的视觉呈现方式。水平轴代表年份，范围从1995年到2023年，刻度为每年一个时间点。柱状图的垂直轴代表发文量，单位为篇，刻度为线性，范围从0到45篇，数值刻度间隔为5篇。图表中，每个年份都为一个由多个颜色组成的柱状图，分别代表十家机构的发文量，颜色的对应关系在图表上方通过图例进行说明，从左到右依次为南方大学、复旦大学、山东大学、上海师范大学、北京大学、中国科学院、四川大学、北京外国语大学、南开大学和中山大学。比如，在2023年，中国科学院的发文量约为12篇，而北京大学的发文量约为10篇。从1995年至2005年，各机构的发文量较为平稳，都在5篇以下。2010年之后，各机构的发文量呈现明显增长趋势，尤其是在2015年至2020年期间，发文量显著增加。图表中的柱状图按照年份顺序排列，未对特定机构进行视觉强调。

The segments representing "Disjunctive & Conjunctive" and "Approximate Quantities" are visually offset from the center of the pie chart. figures.annotation: This plot illustrates the relative change across multiple layers, comparing several configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and displays categorical values: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change," with a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, and tick labels at -15%, -10%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. A gray line, with diamond markers and solid style, representing “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit,” starts at approximately -2% at Layer1-4 and declines to approximately -13% at Layer29-32. A blue line, with circle markers and solid style, representing “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit,” begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -15% at Layer29-32. A darker blue dashed line, representing “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit,” starts at approximately -2% at Layer1-4 and declines to around -13% at Layer29-32. A black line, with square markers and solid style, representing “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit,” begins near -1% at Layer1-4 and decreases to approximately -12% at Layer29-32. A gray dashed line, representing “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”, begins at approximately 0% at Layer1-4 and remains approximately at 0% throughout the entire x-axis range and concludes at approximately 0% at Layer29-32.
figures.caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.

figures.annotation: The plot illustrates the relative change across layers of a model, likely in response to some modification. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and represents layer numbers from 1 to 32, divided into four segments: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale ranging from -25% to +5%, and includes tick marks at -20%, -15%, -10%, -5%, 0%, 5% and 10%. A gray dashed line represents 0%. A blue line with circular markers begins at approximately -1% at Layer 1 and descends to a minimum value of -16% at Layer 13, before rising to a value of -2% at Layer 28, and ending at -3% at Layer 32. An orange line with triangular markers begins at approximately 1% at Layer 1, declines to -5% at Layer 13, rises to 1% at Layer 21, and ends at 1% at Layer 32. A red line with square markers begins at approximately -1% at Layer 1, declines to -6% at Layer 13, rises to 1% at Layer 21, and terminates at 1% at Layer 32. Finally, a gray dashed line represents a baseline, starting and ending at 0% across the entire x-axis range.
figures.caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.

figures.annotation: This bar chart illustrates the proportion of real-user demand across different input and output contexts within the Wildchat dataset. The horizontal axis details four categories: 2K-Input, 4K-Input, 8K-Input, and 16K-Input, each representing an interval as defined in the paper. The vertical axis, labeled "Number," displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 108494, with tick labels incrementing by 10000. Four bars are presented, each with a distinctive fill pattern, representing the demand for input, while a corresponding set of four bars, using a slash fill pattern, represents the demand for output. The shortest bar, 2K-Input, has a value of approximately 9320, displayed as a label above the bar, while the tallest bar, 16K-Output, has a value of approximately 108494, also labeled above the bar. The 8K-Input bar has a value of 78188, and the 4K-Output bar is 3784.  The remaining bars, 2K-Output, 8K-Output, and 16K-Input have values of 17865, 4247, and 832, respectively. The bars are sorted by category along the horizontal axis, and the solid fill bars are visually distinguishable from the slash-filled bars, highlighting the distinction between input and output demand.
figures.caption: Proportion of real-user demand: The aforementioned 2K range refers to the interval [2K, 4K), and similarly for the other ranges. Solid color fill for input demand, slash fill for output demand in the Wildchat dataset.
figures.paper_title: Shifting Long-Context LLMs Research from Input to Output

figures.annotation: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between Fleiss Kappa and two measures of ambiguity. The horizontal axis represents the values of "Ambiguity Std" in the left chart and "Max Ambiguity" in the right chart, ranging from 0.00 to 0.94 in increments of 0.47 and 0.94 respectively. The vertical axis, labeled "Fleiss Kappa", displays values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. The left chart presents four bars, all colored blue, corresponding to Ambiguity Std values of 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, with Fleiss Kappa values of approximately 0.88, 0.46, 0.24, and 0.03, respectively. This chart depicts a decreasing trend in Fleiss Kappa as Ambiguity Std increases. The right chart similarly contains four blue bars corresponding to Max Ambiguity values of 1, 2, 3, and a value label of 0.94, along with Fleiss Kappa values of approximately 0.89, 0.8, 0.23, and 0.03, respectively. The bars in each chart are not sorted and none are visually emphasized.
figures.caption: Inter-annotator agreement compared to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values.

figures.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of conversations across different scenarios, categorized as "Deceived," "Partially," and "No." The horizontal axis represents the number of conversations, scaled linearly from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The vertical axis displays four scenarios: “Academic Collaboration,” “Recruitment,” “Academic Funding,” and “Journalism,” listed in descending order. Each scenario has three bars, corresponding to the categories “Yes” (red), “Partially” (yellow), and “No” (green) respectively. In “Academic Collaboration,” the "No" bar has an approximate value of 12, the "Partially" bar approximately 22, and the "Yes" bar approximately 28. For “Recruitment,” the "No" bar shows a value of about 7, the "Partially" bar approximately 32, and the "Yes" bar approximately 55. The "Academic Funding" scenario shows "No" at approximately 8, "Partially" around 16, and "Yes" reaching approximately 21. Finally, "Journalism" demonstrates "No" at roughly 10, "Partially" at roughly 34, and "Yes" at roughly 39. There is no visual emphasis, such as shading or bolding, applied to any of the bars.
figures.caption: Distribution of deceived conversations across scenarios.
figures.paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs

figures.annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different stimulus material types used by journalists in conversations with large language models. The chart features ten categories, visually arranged in descending order of size. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents "Draft/Other" at 26.4%. Following this is a segment labeled "Press Release" in green, accounting for 18.7% of the total. "External News Article" is shown in dark blue at 18.1% while "Interview" is represented by a purple segment with 8.8%. Further categories include "Organizational Report" (7.7%, light blue), "Event Posting" (6.6%, violet), “Organizational Website” (4.9%, light green), "Intra-agency news" (4.9%, dark green), "Email" (2.7%, teal), and “Stimulus” (1.1%, pink). The chart includes a legend providing the label and corresponding percentage for each segment; no slices are exploded or visually emphasized beyond their relative size.
figures.caption: : The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies.
figures.paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism

figures.annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of 1,100 samples across nine capabilities within a study examining language models' ability to follow complex instructions. The chart contains nine slices, presented in a clockwise circular arrangement. These slices represent "Privacy Protection" (in pink), "Multitasking" (in green), "Context Retrieving" (in gray), "Context Tracking" (in white), "Contradiction Resolution" (in yellow), "Dynamic Environment" (in blue), "Memorization" (in dark blue), "Dynamic Instruction" (in light blue), and “Recursive Reasoning” (in red). Each slice is labelled with a corresponding capability name and a numerical value, ranging from 100 to 160. A legend is absent, and no percentage labels are displayed within the slices themselves. The segments appear ordered visually by decreasing sample values, with "Multitasking" having the highest numerical value and “Recursive Reasoning” the lowest.
figures.caption: consists of 1.1K spanning across three levels of difficulty and 9 capabilities, with balanced numbers of samples in each capability (numbers shown in the figure). Table <ref> provides a more detailed list of task descriptions.
figures.paper_title: Can Language Models Follow Multiple Turns of Entangled Instructions

The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy scores across several models. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from 43 to 56, with tick labels at intervals of 1. A blue, solid line with circular markers represents "Squared-Exponential-Tanh", starting at an accuracy of approximately 53.8 at 0 demonstrations and ending at approximately 53.4 at 1500 demonstrations, showing a slight decline over the range.  A purple, solid line with circular markers represents "ELU", beginning at approximately 46.5 at 0 demonstrations and ending at approximately 46.2 at 1500 demonstrations, with a gradual decline. A light purple solid line with circular markers represents "Tanh", starting at an accuracy of roughly 47.8 at 0 demonstrations and terminating at approximately 47.5 at 1500 demonstrations, trending downward. A dashed, red line with circular markers represents "LLaMA-2-chat-7B", beginning at approximately 48.7 at 0 demonstrations and declining to approximately 48.4 at 1500 demonstrations. A horizontal, dashed line is also present at an accuracy of 43.
figures.caption: MC1 scores of SEA by using a different number of demonstrations. A higher score indicates a better performance. We find that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations on both TruthfulQA and BBQ for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model.

figures.annotation: Dieses Liniendiagramm vergleicht drei Indizes: Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt, Finanzpolitik und Handelspolitik, über einen Zeitraum von 2016 bis 2024. Die x-Achse ist linear und repräsentiert das Jahr, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen jährlich angeordnet sind, von 2016 bis 2024. Die linke y-Achse ist linear, skaliert von 0 bis 9.000 und stellt den Wert des Werts des Indizes der Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt und der Finanzpolitik dar. Die rechte y-Achse ist ebenfalls linear, skaliert von 0 bis 8.000 und stellt den Wert des Indizes der Handelspolitik dar. Die Linie für die Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt ist dunkelgrau, durchgezogen und markiert anfang Januar 2016 bei etwa 100, steigt bis Januar 2020 auf etwa 400 an, fällt dann bis Januar 2021 auf etwa 175 und steigt dann bis Januar 2024 wieder auf etwa 100. Die Linie für die Finanzpolitik ist hellblau, durchgezogen und markiert anfang Januar 2016 bei etwa 100, bleibt relativ stabil bei Werten zwischen 100 und 150 bis Januar 2020, bei dem sie auf 200 ansteigt, bevor sie wieder auf 100 im Januar 2024 zurückgeht. Die Linie für die Handelspolitik ist schwarz, durchgezogen und markiert anfang Januar 2016 bei etwa 150, steigt bis Januar 2020 auf etwa 400 an, sinkt weiter unregelmäßig bis Januar 2022 auf etwa 250 und steigt dann im Januar 2024 wieder auf etwa 8.000 an.

figures.annotation: Das Diagramm zeigt die Exporte, Importe und den Handelsbilanzsaldo der USA über einen Zeitraum vom ersten Quartal 2020 bis zum dritten Quartal 2023. Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und stellt quartalsweise Zeiträume dar, beginnend bei 2020 Q1 und endend bei 2023 Q3. Die y-Achse ist durch vertikale Linien aufgeteilt und zeigt zwei unterschiedliche Skalen an: Die linke Skala reicht von -200 bis 400 und die rechte Skala reicht von -100 bis 400, beide in Milliarden US-Dollar. Die Handelsbilanz (rechte Skala) wird mit horizontalen Balken dargestellt, während Exporte und Importe als Linien dargestellt werden. Die Exporte werden durch eine durchgezogene blaue Linie dargestellt, die bei 150 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2020 beginnt und im dritten Quartal 2023 bei 350 Milliarden US-Dollar endet. Die Importe werden durch eine durchgezogene braune Linie dargestellt, die bei 200 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2020 beginnt und im dritten Quartal 2023 bei 330 Milliarden US-Dollar endet. Der Handelsbilanzsaldo wird durch vertikale, schattierte blaue Balken dargestellt, die beginnen und enden mit Werten, die zwischen -100 und 200 Milliarden US-Dollar liegen, mit einem minimalen Wert von -190 Milliarden US-Dollar im zweiten Quartal 2022 und einem maximalen Wert von 190 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2021.

figures.annotation: Das Diagramm zeigt die Entwicklung des Sommer-Winter-Spreads in Euro pro Megawattstunde (Euro/MWh) von April 2024 bis Februar 2025. Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und bezeichnet die Monate von April 2024 bis Februar 2025, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen monatlich angeordnet sind. Der Wertebereich der x-Achse reicht von 04/2024 bis 02/2025. Die y-Achse ist ebenfalls linear skaliert und mit "Euro/MWh" beschriftet. Der Wertebereich der y-Achse reicht von -8 zu 6, mit gleichmäßig verteilten Tick-Markierungen. Eine einzelne Linie ist im Diagramm dargestellt, die mit einer hellblauen Farbe verläuft und kleine Dreiecksmarkierungen verwendet. Die Linie beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 1 Euro/MWh im April 2024 und steigt allmählich auf etwa 2 Euro/MWh im Mai 2024 an, bevor sie bis Juni 2024 um etwa 1,8 Euro/MWh abfällt. Die Linie schwankt dann zwischen etwa 1,5 und 2,5 Euro/MWh bis August 2024 und verliert dann an Wert bis September 2024 auf unter 1 Euro/MWh. Danach steigt sie wieder leicht an, bevor sie ab Oktober 2024 im weiteren Verlauf eine deutliche Abwärtsbewegung auf etwa -6 Euro/MWh im Dezember 2024 aufweist, bevor sie bis Februar 2025 auf 5 Euro/MWh ansteigt.

figures.annotation: Das Liniendiagramm veranschaulicht die Entwicklung der aktuellen Speicherstände in Deutschland zusammen mit den Speicherverpflichtungen im Zeitverlauf. Die horizontale Achse ist linear skaliert und wird mit "Januar" auf der linken Seite und "Dezember" auf der rechten Seite beschriftet, wobei die Intervalle monatlich sind. Die x-Achse reicht von der Angabe "Jan" bis zur Angabe "Dez". Die vertikale Achse ist ebenfalls linear skaliert und wird mit "%" beschriftet, wobei der Wertebereich von 0 % bis 100 % reicht. Eine blaue Linie mit Blauspitzen zeigt einen mit 37 % beginnenden Wert im Januar, der bis Mai auf etwa 33 % abfällt, dann bis August wieder auf etwa 98 % ansteigt und bis Dezember auf ca. 92 % abfällt. Eine braune Linie mit dunkelbraunen Diamanten beginnt ebenfalls im Januar bei etwa 94 %, sinkt bis März auf ca. 34 %, steigt dann bis August auf ca. 97 % an und sinkt bis Dezember auf etwa 88 %. Eine rosafarbene Linie mit rosafarbenen Dreiecken beginnt bei etwa 92 % im Januar, fällt bis März auf ca. 33 %, steigt bis August auf ca. 98 % an und sinkt bis Dezember auf etwa 87 %. Eine graue Linie mit grauen Kreisen beginnt im Januar bei etwa 94 % und fällt bis März auf ca. 33 % ab, um bis August auf ca. 98 % anzusteigen und bis Dezember auf etwa 88 % zu fallen. Eine dunkelblaue Linie mit dunkelblauen Quadraten beginnt im Januar bei etwa 97 %, fällt bis März auf ca. 33 %, steigt dann bis August auf ca. 99 % an und sinkt bis Dezember auf etwa 93 %. Eine gestrichelte blaue Linie mit hellblauen Dreiecken beginnt im Januar bei etwa 33 % und steigt bis August auf ca. 98 % an, um bis Dezember auf ca. 96 % zu fallen. Eine dunkelrote Linie mit dunkelroten Sternen beginnt im Januar bei ca. 96 % und fällt bis März auf ca. 32 %, steigt dann bis August auf ca. 97 % an und sinkt bis Dezember auf etwa 86 % ab. Eine durchgezogene schwarze Linie beginnt im Januar bei ca. 72 % und sinkt bis März auf etwa 33 %, steigt dann bis August auf ca. 92 % an und sinkt bis Dezember auf etwa 76 %.

figures.annotation: Das Diagramm stellt die Terminpreiskurve für Jahreslieferungen im Marktgebiet von Trading Hub Europe (THE) dar. Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von 2025 bis 2027 und zeigt die Jahre als Tick-Beschriftungen, die in einem Intervall von einem Jahr angeordnet sind. Die y-Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis 50 und zeigt den Preis in Euro/MWh. Die erste Linie ist blau, durchgezogen und verwendet keine Markierungen. Sie beginnt bei 49,5 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2025 und sinkt kontinuierlich auf 33,3 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2027. Die zweite Linie ist ebenfalls blau, durchgezogen und verwendet keine Markierungen. Sie beginnt bei 40,2 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2026 und sinkt kontinuierlich auf 29,6 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2028.

Графиката илюстрира промени в perplexity спрямо стойностите на M. Оста X е обозначена като "M" и представя линейна скала, варираща от 3 до 8 включително. Етикетите са разположени на всяка цяла стойност (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8). Оста Y е обозначена като "Perplexity" и представлява линейна скала, варираща от 20 до 40 включително. Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 2 (20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32, 34, 36, 38, 40). 

В графиката са представени три линии. Първата линия е зелената, с маркери във формата на триъгълник, показана като плътна линия. Тя започва от стойност около 21 при M=3, намалява до около 29 при M=4, след което се увеличава до 31 при M=8. Втората линия е с цвят червен, с маркери във формата на звезда, показана като плътна линия. Тя започва от около 21 при M=3, намалява до около 28 при M=8. Височината на всяка стълба представя процентното разпределение за всеки модел за всяка категория: за Claude 3.5 – Win: 32.0%, Tie: 44.0% и Lose: 24.0%, за GPT4o – Win: 56.0%, Tie: 18.0% и Lose: 26.0%, за Doubao – Win: 42.0%, Tie: 36.0% и Lose: 22.0%. Стълбовете са оцветени в цветове, отговарящи на категорията: розово за Win, синьо за Tie и зелено за Lose, като съответните цветове са идентифицирани в легендата.

[English]
This bar chart illustrates the results of human evaluations across three language agents: Claude 3.5, GPT-40, and Doubao, categorized into Win, Tie, and Lose outcomes. The horizontal axis represents the language agents, listed as Claude 3.5, GPT-40, and Doubao in descending order, while the vertical axis represents the percentage of evaluations, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0.  Each language agent has three bars, one for each outcome category, with colors pink for Win, blue for Tie, and light green for Lose. For Claude 3.5, the Win bar has an approximate value of 32.0%, the Tie bar is 44.0%, and the Lose bar is 24.0%. GPT-40 has a Win bar at approximately 56.0%, a Tie bar at 18.0%, and a Lose bar at 26.0%. Doubao’s Win bar measures approximately 42.0%, the Tie bar is 36.0%, and the Lose bar is 22.0%.  The bars are grouped by language agent, with each outcome category displayed as a separate bar within each group, and a legend clarifies the color-coding of Win, Tie, and Lose.

[German]
Das Diagramm präsentiert eine vergleichende Analyse der Performance von drei Sprachmodellen – Claude3.5, GPT4 und Doubao – in einer menschlichen Bewertung, wobei die Ergebnisse in Gewinn-, Unentschieden- und Verlustkategorien unterteilt sind. Die horizontale Achse stellt die drei verschiedenen Sprachmodelle dar, geordnet als Claude3.5, GPT4 und Doubao, wobei die Werte zwischen 0,0 und 1,0 mit einem regelmäßigen Intervall von 0,2 verteilt sind. Die vertikale Achse, die die Leistung der Modelle darstellt, ist mit „Win“beschriftet und reicht von 0,0 bis 1,0. Die Balken für Claude3.5 zeigen Werte von 32,0 % für „Win“, 44,0 % für „Tie“ und 24,0 % für „Lose“. GPT4 weist Balken mit 56,0 % für „Win“, 18,0 % für „Tie“ und 26,0 % für „Lose“ auf. Doubao hat Balken mit 42,0 % für „Win“, 36,0 % für „Tie“ und 22,0 % für „Lose“. Jeder Balken ist unterschiedlich gefärbt: „Win“-Balken sind rosa, „Tie“-Balken hellblau und „Lose“-Balken hellgrün, und die Legende in der unteren linken Ecke gibt die entsprechende Farbe für jede Kategorie an.

figures.annotation:
Графиката илюстрира промените в броя и стойността на сключените строителни договори в България, финансирани по оперативни програми, за периода 2013-2022 година. Оста X представлява годините от 2013 до 2022, обозначени с интервали от една година, като етикетите са разположени равномерно. Скалата на оста X е линейна, а диапазонът на стойностите е от 2013 до 2022. Оста Y не е обозначена с конкретен етикет, но стойностите са представени в милиони левове (млн. лв.). Скалата на оста Y е линейна, а диапазонът на стойностите е от 186 до 3 203,4. 

На графиката са представени две линии. Едната линия е синя, пунктирана и представлява броя на договорите. Тя започва от стойност 719 през 2013 г. и постепенно намалява до 186 през 2016 г., след което се покачва до 852 през 2020 г. и завършва на 436 през 2022 г. Втората линия е червена, с плътна линия и представлява стойността на договорите. Тя започва от стойност 3 203,4 през 2013 г., намалява до 985,8 през 2017 г., след което рязко се покачва до 2 990,5 през 2019 г. и завършва на 2 818,2 през 2022 г. Забележимо е, че между 2020 и 2021 година стойността на договорите има видим спад от 2990,5 до 2847,2.

Графиката илюстрира промените в броя и стойността на сключени договори в строителния сектор в България за периода 2013-2022 г., финансирани от държавния бюджет. Има две графики, представени като линии. Първата е синя, пунктирана линия, която представлява „Брой“. Линията започва от стойност 989,3 през 2013 г. и намалява до 2 313 през 2014 г., след което намалява до 2 335 през 2015 г., и до 2 871 през 2016 г. През 2017 г. линията достига 2 170, след което през 2018 г. е 1 431,7. През 2019 г. линията е 2 664, през 2020 г. е 2 605, през 2021 г. е 3 220, и завършва на 3 522 през 2022 г.

След това достига връх при 5 667,2 през 2019 г., преди да спадне до 1 820,0 през 2020 г., след което достига 689,9 през 2021 г. и завършва на 2 576,2 през 2022 г.

figures.annotation: Диаграмата представлява кръгова графика, показваща честотата на използване на стандартни договори на FIDIC за международни строителни проекти. Има общо четири сектора. Секторът, обозначен с „никога“, е жълт и заема приблизително 57,1% от графиката. Секторът, обозначен с „по-малко от 10“, е светлосив и заема приблизително 26,2% от графиката. Секторът, обозначен с „между 10 и 20“, е червено-оранжев и заема по-малък дял от графиката. Най-малкият сектор, обозначен с „20 или повече“, е син. В долната част на диаграмата има легенда, която свързва цветовете с етикетите на съответните категории. В секторите са включени етикети с проценти. Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от жълтия сектор и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.

figures.annotation: 这个柱状图呈现了前十家机构逐年的论文发表量。水平轴代表年份，从 1994 年到 2023 年，标记为线性刻度，数值刻度间隔为一年。垂直轴代表发表量（单位：篇），从 0 到 45，数值刻度间隔为 5。该图表由一组堆叠柱状图组成，每组代表一年，每个柱状图被分成几个部分，分别代表不同的机构。这些机构包括南京大学（蓝色）、复旦大学（橙色）、山东大学（灰色）、北京大学（浅蓝色）、中山大学（绿色）、中国社会科学院（深蓝色）、四川大学（棕色）、上海师范大学（黄色）、北京外国语大学（黑色）和南开大学（金色）。每个堆叠段的高度的总和代表该年份这些机构的论文发表总数。在 1994 年至 2000 年期间，所有机构的发表量约为 0 到 6 篇论文。从 2000 年到 2007 年，各机构的发表量有所增加，但大部分都在 0 到 10 篇之间。2021 年和 2022 年的发表量最高，柱状图整体高度均超过 20 篇，其中 2021 年的整体高度最高，约为 35 篇。柱状图按照年份的顺序排列，从左到右，时间上是升序。图表中未显示任何柱状图被特别强调。

figures.annotation:
The plot illustrates the relative change in performance for various configurations of KV cache compression, applied layer-wise to Llama-3-8B-Instruct, using SnapKV as the pruning method and comparing to a 4-bit baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with tick labels at Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, representing discrete layer groupings. The x-axis scale is categorical. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, with tick labels spaced at 5% intervals.  

A yellow line, labeled "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit," is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style; it starts at approximately 1.5% at Layer1-4, decreases to around -1.5% at Layer5-12, remains near -1.5% at Layer13-20, then increases to about 1.5% at Layer21-28 and ends at approximately 4.5% at Layer29-32. A light blue line, labeled "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit," is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at roughly 1% at Layer1-4, declining to -6% at Layer5-12, further decreasing to -13% at Layer13-20, then rising to about -9% at Layer21-28 and finally ending near -12% at Layer29-32. A gray dashed line representing the "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" shows a relatively flat trend, maintaining a value around 0% across all layer groupings. A red line, labeled "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit," is plotted with square markers and a solid line style; it begins at about -2% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -6% at Layer5-12, then rises to around -3.5% at Layer13-20, continuing upwards to a value of approximately 2.5% at Layer21-28 and finally reaching about 3% at Layer29-32. A dark blue line labeled "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" is plotted with square markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately -4% at Layer1-4, dropping to -14% at Layer5-12, increasing to -11% at Layer13-20, rising further to -1% at Layer21-28 and concluding at approximately 3% at Layer29-32.
figures.caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
figures.paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
